notes: THE HEADLINE FIND FOR PHU QUOC. A genuine club lounge — the Connectivity Lounge, 08:00-23:00 daily with one buffet-style F&B presentation — at a resort that is ABSENT from Accor's official Executive Lounge list, verified against today's extraction. AGE RESTRICTION: children are welcome in the lounge generally when supervised, but under-16s are NOT permitted during Connectivity Social Hour; families are directed to Lighthouse restaurant instead. ALCOHOL IS WINDOWED: complimentary during the 17:30-18:30 social hour only, charged at all other times — do not read the 08:00-23:00 opening as all-day free drinks. DO NOT CONFUSE WITH THE PAID OFFER: Beach House runs a separate buy-1-get-1 promotion 19:00-22:00 daily which is public and paid, carries a 15% ALL Accor+ Explorer discount, and is explicitly 'Not eligible for Executive Privilege Pass' — i.e. the lounge pass does not stack with it.
